GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped fairly Restrained Off Mid-Field Two Wide 6 Lengths shuffled well back + Wide Turn Not Given Much Hope # forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was steadied after improving up onto heels. Near 50m was accidently struck across nose by whip of another rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Not Bustled 3rd last Two Wide 7 Lengths 1200m, started to creep into the race Middle Of Track from the 600m and looked to be traveling at the 400m, No Match for impressive winner from the corner but held Clear second spot # one better

Away evenly. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace until improving slowly 3 Wide from 700m. Worked to =lead 3 Wide @ 400m & pressured Five Wide (1/2L from lead) on home turn. Boxed on until weakened in last 150m. # Wide/stuck on OK.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover for the majority of the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly Settled 2nd last 9 Lengths . worked forward out Wide approaching 600m getting to 3rd prior to Straightening Up . was 3 Lengths off, Battled On Well for 3rd # made long run
Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down Off Mid-Field 3 Wide With Trail 6 Lengths crept forward mid-race No Cover Joined in early Set  task # wide/solid
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide without cover from the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled back at tail 8 Lengths . began to work forward approaching home turn Straightening Up 3 Lengths from the Leader . Joined in near 150m, got upperhand & kicked Clear # Finished Too Well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced wide without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled 5th 7 Lengths . worked forward to be within 3 Lengths of Leader on Straightening Up , Battled On Well but was no match for the winner # ok but no excuses

Jumped Well , Went Forward Settled Down Two Wide 2nd, 1 length @ 1400m. Moved Up within a neck into Straight but Leader was traveling better. this held Clear 2nd last 200m, Leader kicked on. 3.5L back to 3rd # 2nd all way/1st led

Jumped Ok Settled 2nd last 9 Lengths . worked forward out Wide approaching 600m to be up challenging for Lead Soon After . Took over in Straight , Joined near 200m, engaged in 2 horse war doing just enough to score # headbobbing finish
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover from the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down Just Off Pace 3wide No Cover 2 Lengths Lost Ground to Straightening Up Ridden Along 4l Weakened to the line # Wide NC/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th With Trail 4 Lengths Joined in 500 (winner followed) no match space to 3rd # Sound Effort
Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled 3rd 2 Lengths . worked forward on Turn , Took Lead in Straight , grabbed right on the line by one flying down Middle Of Track # had his chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.
